en: A colorized panoramic view of a European city in a river valley, seen from an elevated vantage point. The scene shows dense blocks of multi‑story buildings with red and light-colored roofs along both banks of a winding river. A metal bridge crosses the river in the foreground. Rolling green hills and distant mountains frame the background. At the top left, red printed text reads in German, likely serving as the postcard title.
